people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.
translations.bsb: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Reuben is 151,450; they shall set out second.
translations.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
translations.asv: All that were numbered of the camp of Reuben were a hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth second.
